_comment: Knobs for kce_intake. No secrets live here: the sign-in token is cached under %LOCALAPPDATA%\kce_intake, never under OneDrive.
_projectsRootComment: One folder per MTX, named '<MTX> - <slug>'. Lives in the synced SharePoint folder so Corinne sees the same files. _unmatched/ and _needs_manual/ sit beside the project folders.
_dropFoldersComment: Anything a person saves here is picked up on the next sync. The original is left where it is; intake records its hash so it is filed once.
_pipelineComment: pipelineCwd null = the kce-pipeline folder this package lives in. The pipeline runs as a subprocess, so intake never imports it.
